top_signals.title: Bloomberg Brief 11/23/2026
top_signals.summary: US equity futures rebound from a rout in the AI trade that sent the S&P 500 into a correction. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent warns that the Federal Reserve risks jeopardizing the US economy by overtightening in response to the latest inflation data. CrowdStrike agrees to acquire cybersecurity provider Zscaler in an all-stock transaction valued at about $43.9 billion. Kamakshya Trivedi of Goldman Sachs joins “Bloomberg Brief” to discuss the latest market recovery. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Hedge Funds’ $1 Billion Arbitrage Win in Cayman Is Under Threat
top_signals.summary: Investment firms that reaped a $1 billion award on a bet challenging the $2.59 billion take-private deal for China’s Sina Corp. now face the possibility that they’ll never be paid.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Macron proposes French budget ‘golden rule’
top_signals.summary: President suggests constitutional reform to cap government spending and keep future deficits in check, echoing proposals by opponents
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
